m: साट् cl. 10. P. साटयति, to make visible or manifest, Dhātup. xxxv, 84.

s: t ka prakASane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adantacurA॰-para॰-aka॰-sew .) dvitIyasvarayuktasakArAdirayam । asasAwat । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: prakASane ada॰ cu॰ u॰ sa॰ sew । sAwayati te asasAwat ta
tri॰ sahAwopena sahasya saH । 1 sagarve 2 vikawe ca ।
m: साटोप mfn. puffed up, self-conceited, proud, arrogant, Vās.
a: साटोप — a. 1 Elated or puffed up with pride, haughty. --2 Majestic, stately. --3 Swollen, filled or charged with, (as with water); Pt. 1. --पं ind. Proudly, arrogantly, in a stately manner, struttingly; as in साटोपं परिक्रामति.

m: साट्टाल m. or n. (?) a palace (v.l. for साद्दाल), Bhadrab.
साट्टहास mfn. with loud laughter (अम् ind.), MārkP.
